p.x:
My feeling is that the main thing obstructing enjoyment of the "journey" of making AI art is an interface problem. The interfaces are (mostly) being made by engineers for ordinary members of the public

We need interfaces that enable greater intuitive flow and finer control

For instance, a think a tablet + stylus + voice interface could be amazing. Picture this: 
You're working on an illustration
→ Something is off about the lower left
→ You gesture to zoom in
→ Ah - the linework needs more definition
→ You circle the exact area
→ "Linework needs more definition"
→ The AI does it within that section

You could also add:
• Eye-tracking – so you can just say "zoom in" and the AI can just see where you want to zoom in
• Auto-suggest – where the AI picks up on what you're trying to do & suggests several completed versions of it. (This way you don't need to use as many words – words often break me out of intuitive flow)
• Dynamic haptics – the tablet adds ridges, grain, friction so you can FEEL the linework. It would be like drawing on paper except with even *more* texture

Combine it all, and now you have possibly the most intuitive interface ever made for going directing from idea to realization

Not Our First Rodeo: Rogan believes advanced cultures existed before the Younger Dryas and were wiped out. This may explain the persistent reports of USOs, deep-ocean anomalies, and why modern archaeology so adamantly refuses to engage with ancient but highly advanced engineering techniques. 

UFO Crash Retrievals, Secrecy & Apocalyptic AI: Rogan thinks the US has recovered exotic materials and that secrecy is now a national security risk. If China breaks the physics first, the balance of power shifts instantly. We dive deep into his interview with the original UFO Whistleblower Bob Lazar, which originally cracked United States UFO reverse engineering programs wide open. Rogan warns that AI and the quantum revolution could unlock the architecture of non-human technology establishing an unprecedented leap in human capabilities. I then ask Joe what the result would be if Elon Musk had to debate David Grusch. His answer is telling...

Psychedelics and Alien Contact: Rogan calls DMT “a hotline to the universe”. He describes doing 5MeO and seeing fractals and other unfathomable imagery. He thinks consciousness may be an interface and that future contact might occur internally as it manifests physically.

Ancient Structures and Suppressed Data: Rogan points to global megalithic architecture, impossible construction methods, and coherent patterns across continents as evidence of an erased technological history. Academia and various ministry of cultures’ resistance, in his view, are institutional protectionism. We discuss the absolute reality of cylindrical structures underneath the pyramids going a kilometer deep with coils around them along with a 40 meter “tic tac” shaped object at the labyrinth at Hawara Egypt. If you connect these with the statements that Bob Lazar made -- that many UFOs in American possession are ancient structures from archeological digs -- things get trippy.

JFK, Nixon & The Moon Landing: We get DEEP on all of the facts around what happened with the JFK assassination (Oswald was clearly not a lone actor), the Watergate Scandal (how it bizarrely connects with JFK’s assassination but was also a plot to take out Nixon) and the moon landing (we explore all of the facts in maybe the most unfiltered way Joe’s ever done). Spoiler alert: whatever you think happened, its painfully obvious that the conventional narrative on all of these things are way off. We also talk about Kissinger, Cheney and "the government behind our government" (possibly connecting with the UFO issue). 

The 10-Year Horizon: Rogan says humanity is approaching a convergence: UFO crash retrieval transparency. AI outpacing human cognition and merging with it. A rediscovery of ancient knowledge and potential alien contact. The confluence of these trends are almost inconceivable. 

He thinks the next decade will force a reckoning with who we are and what's been before us. If you want to hear Joe Rogan speak directly about contact, consciousness, ancient technology, the future of mankind and just about every American conspiracy under the sun this is the episode.

After Jacob Coxon's resignation and extinction warnings, a lot of people are asking 'how could AI possibly kill everyone?' and claiming AI safety researchers have no realistic answer.

This is false! Here are the 5 best scenarios I know of:

AI 2027: https://t.co/CaTNvafRI7 (I strongly recommend this one for being realistic, engaging, and if you dig into the appendices, highly detailed)

Paul Christiano's scenario (Former Head of Safety @ AISI, 2019): https://t.co/nkhTQJnjuS

Gwern Branwen's scenario (widely known independent AI researcher, 2022): https://t.co/WMmlDESf7g

Holden Karnofsky's high-level explanation (RSP Lead @ Anthropic, 2022): https://t.co/mAsLNdggQj

Joshua Clymer's scenario (ex-OpenAI, 2025): https://t.co/lJHJp6ErOx

(There's also the Sable story from https://t.co/JbZmSbog25, though you'll have to buy the book to read that one.)

Writing concrete, specific risk scenarios with enormous amounts of detail has been a major research project of many of the most prominent voices in the field! (With the current leaders in effort being https://t.co/YkSOj2urg4 and https://t.co/CaTNvafRI7)
